    ptr += 1
    for _ in range(T):

        for __ in range(M):
            x, y = map(int, input[ptr:ptr+2])
            ptr +=2
            adj[x].append(y)
            adj[y].append(x)
        S = int(input[ptr])
        ptr +=1

        dist = [-1]*(N+1)
        q = deque()

        q.append(S)

        while q:
            u = q.popleft()
            for v in range(1, N+1):
                if v != u and dist[v] == -1 and v not in adj[u]:
